title: IVG Smart Max Retro Orange Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Retro Orange delivers a nostalgic Orange soda flavour with a tangy citrus twist. The profile is sweet and effervescent, capturing the familiar taste of fizzy orange drinks with a fresh finish that keeps the vape light and lively. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir that clicks securely into place. Once connected, the pod is topped up automatically as you vape, potentially providing up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on use. No need for refilling or coil changes. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth vapour production and consistent flavour. This pod is designed exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
